Why are we asking for this info?

Asking for and understanding your pronouns and gender is one step Salsa is taking to make our marketing and communications more equitable and inclusive. We’ll use this information to help customize and tailor the information you receive from Salsa so we can speak with you in a way that reflects the most accurate and authentic version of you! Providing this information is optional, and we’ll never share it with a third party.
